name: S/MIME
description: Signs outgoing e-mails with S/MIME certificates: of the organisation for the senders of the wiki, and personal certificates people upload for e-mails sent in their name. Warns before certificates expire. Optionally seals signature evidence additionally with the certificate of the organisation (checkable with OpenSSL).
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Manage S/MIME certificates
permissions.description: Upload and remove the S/MIME certificates of the organisation and change the S/MIME settings.
